issues.detail: The Hebrew 'גִּבְעָ֑תָה' is a place name (Gibeah), not '小山丘' (small hill). The Chinese renders it as a common noun, losing the proper place name.
The Hebrew 'הַחַיִל' means 'the army' or 'the mighty men' (a group of people), but the Chinese translates it as '力量' (strength/power), changing the subject from people to an abstract force.
